video_title: Post Game Press Conference l J B  Bickerstaff l Pistons vs  Suns   10.05.26

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff praises Abuka's patience and poise in final possession
quotes.excerpt: He's patient and he doesn't get sped up. He's not overwhelmed by the moment.
quotes.quote: He's patient and he doesn't get sped up. He's not overwhelmed by the moment and that's something that we've seen pretty consistently. His demeanor doesn't waver in those types of moments and he just was so poised. He got to his spot and got his shot. At that age to have the ability to finish the way that he can finish is unique. Not a lot of guys can do that with his age and experience, so that's a step ahead for him and to be able to finish over size and traffic with either hand, he's ahead of the game for sure.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff is impressed by Abuka's poise in clutch moments saying he is not overwhelmed by the moment and that his ability to finish over size and traffic at his age is unique

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the front office finding diamonds like Abuka
quotes.excerpt: Our front office has been able to find those diamonds for us.
quotes.quote: Our front office has been able to find those diamonds for us, guys that have come through Motor City, come through our system and worked their way to the team because of his skill set, his ability to work, his physicality, the way he sets screens. But defensively, I thought he's done a great job of protecting the paint. His pick-and-roll defense was elite tonight as well, but he gives us that spark, gives us that energy with the physicality and again he represents who we are.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff credits the Pistons front office for finding diamonds like Abuka noting his elite pick and roll defense and the energy he brings to the team

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff discusses John Collins' versatility and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: His ability to play the four or the five, his ability to stretch the floor.
quotes.quote: We're working through some of these things and just trying to figure out lineups positionally. But his ability to play the four or the five, his ability to stretch the floor, he's been an elite roller through his career also, so he knows how to play the pick-and-roll if he's at the five with those guards. Defensively, his ability to switch on the perimeter, all good things for us. I love his toughness to get into it with seven and a half minutes to go in the first quarter of a preseason game is right up the Pistons' alley.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff on John Collins versatility and defensive impact saying his ability to play the four or five and switch on the perimeter are all good things for the Pistons

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on the development of Asar and team growth
quotes.excerpt: We believe like if he takes a jump, our team is going to take a jump.
quotes.quote: We're trying to experiment with different things. We obviously want Asar to have the ball in his hands. We believe like if he takes a jump, our team is going to take a jump. In order to do that, he's got to get that exposure. So trying to find the right lineups to play out there with him and around him, I think that group had a lot of space, a lot of shooting with good size as well. But I just felt like we need to give him more of those opportunities, going to be the lead dog out there with the ball in his hands so that he continues to take those steps.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff says the Pistons are prioritizing Asar's development as the lead dog noting that if he takes a jump the whole team is going to take a jump

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on coaching Asar to be more aggressive
quotes.excerpt: We want him to be aggressive, but it's aggressive to make the right play.
quotes.quote: He is obviously extremely talented and versatile on both ends of the floor and I think it's he has to be aggressive and able to show that. We want him to be aggressive, but it's aggressive to make the right play, and whether it's two guys on you, you make the pass or the little pull-up, make the right basketball play. But to do that, you have to be aggressive and that's what we want him to be.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff wants Asar to be more aggressive on the floor but emphasizes that it must be an aggression to make the right basketball play

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on offensive struggles and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: We weren't very good offensively, to be honest with you. We didn't execute a lot of things.
quotes.quote: We weren't very good offensively, to be honest with you. We didn't execute a lot of the things that we've been working on. It's some new stuff, so it's to be expected. Once you're playing a different opponent and things start to ramp up, you get to see where you are. Playing them, who's a good physical defensive team, gave us a good test of where we are and it just proves to us that we got more work to do. The great thing is we've got time. I know our guys' skill set and talent, so it'll give us an opportunity to watch it on film, break it down with the guys and then go out and replicate it on the court.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff admits the Pistons were not very good offensively against the Suns saying the team has more work to do as they integrate new systems
